name: Citizenship by Descent (Automatic, Born After 1 April 2015)

qualifying_event.description: A child born on or after 1 April 2015 automatically acquires Swedish citizenship if either parent is a Swedish citizen at the time of birth, or if a deceased parent was Swedish at the time of their death -- regardless of where the child is born, the parents' marital status, or gender.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of Swedish citizenship.

requirement_groups.name: Child of a Swedish citizen parent (born after 1 April 2015)

requirements.blocker_text: Either parent must be a Swedish citizen at the time of the child's birth (or have been Swedish at time of death, if deceased) -- gender- and marital-status-neutral, and independent of birthplace.

sources.title: Swedish Migration Agency -- When does a child automatically become a Swedish citizen?: post-1-April-2015 gender-neutral either-parent rule vs. the more complex, gender-asymmetric pre-2015 rules

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sweden). This file models ONLY the current, simplified post-1-April-2015 rule. The SAME source confirms the pre-2015 rules were genuinely gender-asymmetric and worth flagging for historical/comparative context: a Swedish MOTHER always passed on citizenship automatically (born in Sweden or abroad), while a Swedish FATHER's child needed the parents to be married at the time of birth (if born abroad) for automatic citizenship -- an unmarried Swedish father's child born abroad did not automatically become a citizen and required the father to file a notification. That older regime is not modeled as a live route here since anyone born after 1 April 2015 falls under the current gender-neutral rule and the pre-2015 rule is now a historical/legacy determination rather than a route a person is actively pursuing today; flagged for completeness rather than built as a separate file.
